readerCopy.body: Something from the past can inspire you again without asking you to return to it. Neptune sextile the South Node can bring an old song, image, dream, spiritual practice, creative idea, or memory back in a way that softens the present and opens imagination. Let the association give you material. You can keep what moved you without rebuilding the circumstances around it. Inspiration travels better than nostalgia.
